productConcept.name: AXIOM QUANTUM
productConcept.description: Error-corrected quantum processing platform — 1,024 logical qubits at surface code distance-7, 99.97% gate fidelity, operational deployment for research and commercial quantum computing workloads.
productConcept.rationale: The dark-array aesthetic (Orbitron 900, JetBrains Mono, #fd356e neon signal, #19191c near-black, compressed spacing, .data-grid HUD rails) perfectly maps to a quantum computing interface. The system designation vocabulary (100px uppercase Orbitron labels that read as classifiers not headings), the HUD panel grid populated from query results, and the status-rail accent column all find direct expression in a quantum processor platform. This is a completely different product world from Defense Neural — quantum error correction interfaces have their own vocabulary: qubit counts, coherence times, fidelity percentages, cryogenic temperatures.
